shortDescription: Waits for a process to exist or not exist before continuing.

options.name: owner
options.description: The owner of the process. Requires PowerShell version 4.0 or newer.

options.name: post_wait_delay
options.description: Seconds to wait after checking for processes.

options.name: pre_wait_delay
options.description: Seconds to wait before checking processes.

options.name: process_min_count
options.description: Minimum number of process matching the supplied pattern to satisfy C(present) condition. Only applies to C(present).

options.name: process_name_exact
options.description: The name of the process(es) for which to wait.  The name of the process(es) should not include the file extension suffix.

options.name: sleep
options.description: Number of seconds to sleep between checks. Only applies when waiting for a process to start.  Waiting for a process to start does not have a native non-polling mechanism. Waiting for a stop uses native PowerShell and does not require polling.

options.name: state
options.description: When checking for a running process C(present) will block execution until the process exists, or until the timeout has been reached. C(absent) will block execution until the process no longer exists, or until the timeout has been reached. When waiting for C(present), the module will return changed only if the process was not present on the initial check but became present on subsequent checks. options.name: timeout
options.description: The maximum number of seconds to wait for a for a process to start or stop before erroring out.
